readings: For each observatory station, count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes (its count divided by the total number of telescopes). Among observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, list the `observstation`, the telescope count, the share, and how far the share is above the average (share minus average share), with no rounding. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest and return exactly the first 10 rows; if observatories are tied at the 10th place, just pick any of them to fill the 10 rows. For each observatory station, count its telescopes and work out its share of all telescopes (its count divided by the total number of telescopes). Among observatories whose share is above the average share across all observatories, list the `observstation`, the telescope count, the share, and how far the share is above the average (share minus average share), with no rounding. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest and return exactly the first 10 rows; if observatories are tied at the 10th place, just pick any of them to fill the 10 rows. Consider every observatory in the observatories table, including those with zero telescopes; the average share is 1 divided by the total number of observatories.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_s FROM counts
)
SELECT s.observstation, s.cnt AS telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS diff_from_avg
FROM shares s, avg_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
tot AS (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS total_t,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM observatories) AS total_o
)
SELECT c.observstation,
       c.cnt AS telescope_count,
       CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total_t AS share,
       CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total_t - 1.0 / tot.total_o AS diff_above_avg
FROM counts c, tot
WHERE CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total_t > 1.0 / tot.total_o
ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
